negative_findings.description: VIBER (Valós Idejű Bruttó Elszámolási Rendszer) has no separate operating company and therefore no standalone annual report. It is operated directly by the MNB, so all VIBER operational and volume disclosure is folded into MNB publications (Fizetési rendszer jelentés, MNB éves jelentés, statisztika.mnb.hu).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in Hungarian for a VIBER annual report; only MNB-published reports and statistics were found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents wasted collection effort hunting for a VIBER corporate report and directs monitoring to the correct MNB endpoints.

negative_findings.description: Posta Elszámoló Központ (PEK) appears to be an internal organisational unit of Magyar Posta Zrt., not a separately reporting legal entity. No independent PEK annual report, website or filing was located in Hungarian searches; the only public description found is a Magyar Posta service page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hungarian searches for 'Posta Elszámoló Központ éves jelentés/beszámoló' returned only Magyar Posta service and terms pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Postal clearing volumes must be sought inside Magyar Posta's consolidated accounts and MNB statistics rather than from a PEK-level source.

negative_findings.description: GIRO Zrt.'s narrative 'éves jelentés' series was observed on the document repository only up to 2023, while the statutory 'éves beszámoló' set runs to 2025. It is unclear whether the narrative report for 2024+ has been discontinued or is simply filed under a different category.
negative_findings.result_summary: Repository listing showed éves jelentés 2017-2023 and éves beszámoló 2011-2025.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If the narrative report has been discontinued, the qualitative scheme-strategy commentary must be replaced by MNB reports and press channels.

negative_findings.description: A targeted search for GIRO Zrt.'s own procurement notices in the Közbeszerzési Értesítő returned only the general procurement framework and unrelated notices; no GIRO-specific tender was surfaced in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search engine did not surface GIRO as a named contracting authority; the gazette's own search interface was not queried directly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Whether GIRO publishes tenders as a contracting authority is a load-bearing question for procurement-signal collection and remains unresolved.

negative_findings.description: kozzetetelek.hu was referenced in search-result summaries as an additional statutory publication venue for KELER's annual disclosure data, but the site itself was not fetched or located in this pass; its exact URL and coverage are unconfirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Mentioned only second-hand in a search summary.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: It may be a useful parallel filing registry; recorded as a lead rather than a source to avoid asserting an unverified endpoint.

coverage_gaps.description: GIRO's English-language disclosure footprint was not established. Only Hungarian-language repository content was confirmed; whether an English annual report or English scheme documentation exists is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl giro.hu language switcher / /en paths and search 'GIRO Hungary annual report clearing volumes' in English to confirm or rule out an EN track.

coverage_gaps.description: KELER Group ownership and its shareholders' own reporting (MNB majority, Budapesti Értéktőzsde / BSE minority) were not traced. BSE annual reports would carry a KELER equity-method line and post-trade commentary.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Budapesti Értéktőzsde (bet.hu) investor/annual-report pages as a candidate source in a follow-up pass; confirm the current KELER shareholding split.

coverage_gaps.description: CSDR Article 26 / EMIR public quantitative disclosures and PFMI self-assessments for KELER and KELER KSZF were not individually located, though the disclosure obligation makes their existence near-certain.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl keler.hu and kelerkszf.hu 'Dokumentumtár' / 'Key documents' sections for 'CPMI-IOSCO', 'PFMI', 'nyilvánosságra hozatal' and quarterly EMIR disclosure files.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival/time-machine strategy was established for versioned scheme documents (BKR Üzletszabályzat, Díjszabályzat, Posta Pénzforgalmi Üzletszabályzat), which are overwritten at the canonical URL.

coverage_gaps.description: Adjacent Hungarian clearing/collection infrastructure (e.g. the Díjbeszedő group and its bill-payment clearing role, and any card-scheme domestic processing entity) was not investigated and may belong in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up Hungarian pass on 'Díjbeszedő Holding éves beszámoló', 'számlabefizetés elszámolás', and domestic card-processing operators to test whether they extend the infrastructure actor map.

coverage_gaps.description: No fetch was attempted against keler.hu, kelerkszf.hu, posta.hu, mnb.hu or e-beszamolo.im.gov.hu in this pass; only giro.hu was fetched. All other URLs come from search-engine results and are therefore unverified for liveness.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Let the deterministic liveness pass verify; treat any 403/timeout on posta.hu or mnb.hu as bot defence rather than as a dead link.

brief: Hungary's payment and post-trade infrastructure is a small, state-adjacent set of operators — GIRO Zrt. (BKR/GIROInstant, MNB-owned), KELER Zrt. and KELER KSZF Zrt. (CSD and CCP), Magyar Posta Zrt. with its internal Posta Elszámoló Központ, and VIBER which the MNB operates itself — and each of the corporate entities maintains a well-structured Hungarian-language document repository carrying audited annual accounts, narrative annual reports and statutory közérdekű adatok disclosures. The highest-value layer sits above the operators: the MNB's annual Fizetési rendszer jelentés and the statisztika.mnb.hu interbank turnover series are the authoritative consolidated statements on VIBER, BKR and KELER volumes, availability and incidents, and are the only reporting VIBER has at all. Two structural caveats shape collection: PEK is an internal Magyar Posta unit with no standalone reporting, and GIRO's narrative éves jelentés series appears to stop at 2023 while its statutory beszámoló continues to 2025. Scheme rulebooks and tariff schedules plus the Közbeszerzési Értesítő procurement gazette are the strongest forward-looking, procurement-relevant signals, since they surface pricing changes and modernisation spend well before the annual reports narrate them.
